docs: Testimonials content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of one to six quotes, each with the words, the author, a role line and a portrait. One object is valid in every testimonials layout (cards in columns, rows with the portrait at the side, one centred quote).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

quotes.docs: the quotes, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

avatar.docs: address of the portrait; none: the placeholder

description.docs: the role and the company of the author; empty: none
